dungeons.name: The Whispering Crypts
dungeons.treasure: Iron Key, basic armor, health potions
dungeons.lore: The first light that ever fell on this world. It warms even now, faintly, behind ancient stone.
dungeons.theme: Undead burial grounds — dusty crypts, crumbling sarcophagi

dungeons.name: The Goblin Warrens
dungeons.treasure: Shaman's Amulet, stolen gear, goblin-crafted helm
dungeons.lore: The last light before night. Patient. It has waited here for centuries without complaint.
dungeons.theme: Chaotic goblin civilization — low ceilings, rope bridges, cooking fires

dungeons.name: The Flooded Vaults
dungeons.treasure: Vault Master's Ring, underwater breathing amulet
dungeons.lore: The breath of the sky, compressed into stone. It has not forgotten where it came from.
dungeons.theme: Ancient treasure vault — half-submerged, mineral-streaked walls, bubbles rising

dungeons.name: Ember Depths
dungeons.lore: The first fire was not made by humans. This piece remembers that.
dungeons.theme: Volcanic caverns — active lava flows, steam vents, cracked rock

dungeons.name: The Frozen Abyss
dungeons.lore: The cold does not hate. It simply does not care. This is the piece that was there when the world first exhaled.
dungeons.theme: Glacial cavern — ice walls, frozen breath, slippery floors, things frozen inside walls

dungeons.name: The Shattered Halls
dungeons.lore: The earth does not break easily. This piece is all that broke.
dungeons.theme: Ancient dwarven complex — gears, pulleys, counterweights, rubble

dungeons.name: The Howling Spire
dungeons.lore: Wind does not follow the same rules. It was the first to leave the Sunstone and the last to slow down.
dungeons.theme: Collapsed wizard's tower — vertical dungeon, wind currents, open sky

dungeons.name: The Void Chambers
dungeons.lore: Shadow is not the absence of light. The Sunstone knew this. This piece is the proof.
dungeons.theme: Sub-dimensional space — reality unstable, walls shift, gravity anomalies

dungeons.name: The Crystal Sanctum
dungeons.treasure: Scholar's Codex, Scholar's Ring, aureate gear
dungeons.lore: The Circle put this one here on purpose. This is where they thought the world would be safest.
dungeons.theme: Aureate Circle HQ — white and gold stone, light crystals, automata guardians

dungeons.name: The Final Descent
dungeons.lore: Life did not need a name until the Sunstone broke. Now it does.
dungeons.theme: The ruins of Aldenmere — all environments collide, Dorevus awaits
